prompts.rider: Create a production-ready transparent PNG sprite animation atlas for Speed Rovers, an original 2.5D painted-sprite motorcycle racer. Reference image is the existing rider's identity and pose layout, not an edit mask. Red sport motorcycle, black full-face helmet, navy leather suit with red shoulder yoke and thin white chevron, brown gloves/boots, twin exhausts. Redraw with richly detailed hand-painted 1990s PC racing-game realism: tangible leather folds, metal highlights, rubber tire, readable tail lamp, compact muscular anatomy, no cartoon outlines, no 3D-render plastic look. EXACT grid 5 columns x 3 rows of equal cells, on genuine transparent background, no borders/text/shadows/ground. Each cell contains one complete rear-view bike+rider, centered horizontally, rear tire contact at 94 percent cell height; head at about 7 percent cell height. Same size/camera throughout. Columns left to right: hard lean left, mild lean left, upright, mild lean right, hard lean right. Lean rotates bike and torso around the rear tire contact; no side views. Rows are consecutive subtle suspension/tire animation phases: neutral, compressed, recovered. Keep wheel contact and silhouette scale consistent in every frame, no detached pieces, no overlapping cells, generous transparent gutter. Atlas approximately 1600x1440, each cell wider than needed so leaning sprites fit. Original artwork, no borrowed logos.

Row2 Mexico City: warm late-afternoon sky, volcanic distant mountains, low stucco city silhouette and dry mesas.
